headline: Growth is hot and inflation is re-accelerating (Q3 GDP 4.3%, October core PCE 3.3%), and markets price a Dec 9 hike at roughly 97%, so assume policy keeps tightening into 2027. Long yields eased before the holiday (10-year ~4.85%), but keep hurdle rates anchored near a 4.9–5.0% 10-year plus 25–50 bp of expected tightening, and budget wide and still-widening high-yield spreads (~370 bp) on any levered financing. Energy relief is fading at the margin: Brent jumped to ~$95 after the Ras Tanura strike, though it is still well below early-November levels.
